citeAs: Cimpoi, M., Maji, S., Kokkinos, I., Mohamed, S., and Vedaldi, A. (2014). Describing Textures in the Wild. In 2014 IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, pages 3606–3613, Columbus, OH, USA. IEEE.
creator: M. Cimpoi, S. Maji, I. Kokkinos, S. Mohamed, A. Vedaldi
description: The Describable Textures Dataset (DTD) is a texture image dataset containing 5640 images sourced from Flickr across 47 texture categories such as polka-dotted, scaly, and striped. It is widely used in computer vision and machine learning for texture recognition and analysis tasks.
name: Describable Textures Dataset (DTD)
rai:dataCollection: Images were collected from Flickr and organized into 47 texture categories such as polka-dotted, scaly, and striped, resulting in 5640 images total.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images sourced from Flickr across 47 texture categories.
rai:dataUseCases: Texture recognition and classification in computer vision and machine learning; used as a reference dataset for evaluating texture quality and diversity of generated texture datasets; used for measuring texture bias in models.
